test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: The two are in most cases mutualy exclusive.
The two are in most cases mutuallyy exclusive.
The two are in most cases mutually exclusive.
The two are in most casies mutually exclusive.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The two are in most cases mutually exclusive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**mutually**' is spelt correctly in this sentence.
 
• '**Mutually**' means in a way that is shared or reciprocal, in a mutual manner. (एक तरह से जो साझा
